text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Training was way tougher than usual this 
week... I'm completely wiped out~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El had supplementary math classes today, 
and she is ex-haus-ted...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, don't get so sloppy over something 
like this. Pull yourself together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since training is off for today, why don't 
we all just take it easy~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A relaxing game, huh... How about playing 
cards, then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Old Maid, huh... Man, it's been so long~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone has their cards now, yes! Then 
let us begiiin, DEEE-SU!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right... Ugh!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, are you maybe creeped out by 
this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go first. I just need to pull 
Special Week-san's, right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! B-Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha-!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aaah. It went to King this time, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I'm at a good pace. Trust the 
current momentum...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: This is the one!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ! Ohohoho! You fell right into my trap!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wha-!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(To think I'd draw the short straw at a 
time like this...!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's El's turn to draw Tsuru-chan's 
card-desu! Which one should I pick~...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Over here, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No way!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Que?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pick from that side—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Please don't run away!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest El won't let you get 
away! Everyone, help catch Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... To think you swapped 
them while you were running away... You 
got me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Here, Grass, go ahead...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then I'll choose the one on the left—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I won't let you draw that one, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah...! El!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... We were just playing cards, 
so why on earth are we playing tag now...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the cafeteria, I saw Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi and the others completely worn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's just Old Maid, I give it my 
all...! I don't like losing, even in 
games!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one more time! I won't lose next 
time!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do it one more time!
No, why don't we take a rest soon?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh... You're still doing more...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna play with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Man, this is gonna leave everyone 
completely exhausted..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the whole point was to take it 
easy~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No way……! Tsuyoshi can still keep 
go—*cough* *hack*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the group continued to play 
while somehow managing to soothe the 
all-out Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
